key_insight: SevenNet-Polar extends an equivariant graph neural network to predict Born effective charges alongside energy, forces, and stress with high accuracy, enabling fast charge-aware atomistic simulation under electric fields.
engineering_relevance: This can substantially lower the cost of modeling ferroelectrics, perovskites, and defected oxides in device-relevant electric-field conditions, supporting larger and more realistic simulations.
method: Equivariant SevenNet-based graph neural network for BEC prediction
Multitask models jointly predict energy, forces, stress, and BEC
Accelerated inference with FlashTP for large-scale GPU simulations
evidence_signal: The abstract reports BEC-only RMSE as low as 0.0043 e and multitask performance of 1.0 meV/atom energy, 12 meV/angstrom forces, 0.05 GPa stress, and 0.0029 e BEC on ZrO2 and Li3PO4.
watch_item: Performance may depend on coverage of high-temperature, defect, and out-of-distribution structures, so extrapolation to unseen electric-field environments should be validated carefully.
paper_title: SevenNet-Polar for MultiTask Prediction of Energy, Forces, Stress, and Born Effective Charges: Development and Application to ZrO$_2$, Li$_3$PO$_4$, and Perovskites
